2.5.8 Duolingo 
Duolingo is an educational app that focuses on languages and has also branched 
out to music and mathematics (Apple, 2024). Duolingo has fully embraced 
psychological methods to increase its usage and effectiveness (Luis, 2023). 
This documents author reviews a few of the strategies used to increase usage: 
1. Gamification – by utilising scores and badges, to likely increase 
engagement and student willingness to learn. 
2. Social competition – with the use of leader boards and rankings, likely 
increasing student engagement and motivation. 
3. Operant conditioning – techniques are used such as streaks (negative 
punishment), and score penalties for mistakes (positive punishment). 
The app does limit self-regulation, by restricting access to certain lessons behind 
a knowledge exam, however it may be argued that this is to prevent students 
from being discouraged. It may also be argued that the gamified elements 
increase extraneous load, alternately these are the elements that keep users 
returning to the app (Luis, 2023), and continuing to learn. 
Duolingo seems to be highly like by its students, with a rating of 4.7 stars on 
(Apple, 2024). Most reviews claim that they find it enjoyable and find that they 
learned a lot from it. 
In summary Duolingo seems to almost align with the scientific literature 
perfectly, creating a highly effective and engaging application.
